nodes.label: RISK: Private Key Stored in localStorage (Web)

properties.description: On Platform.OS === 'web', raw private key written to localStorage via localStorage.setItem('kryptonow_vault', privKey). localStorage is accessible to any JS on the page (XSS attack surface).

nodes.norm_label: risk: private key stored in localstorage (web)

nodes.label: RISK: Hardcoded Alchemy API Key Fallback

properties.description: EXPO_PUBLIC_ALCHEMY_KEY has a hardcoded fallback 'HJfOuVkHmg_PM66WyXNjT' that will be compiled into the app bundle if the env var is missing.
properties.app_store_impact: API key exposed in binary — key abuse risk

nodes.norm_label: risk: hardcoded alchemy api key fallback

nodes.label: RISK: Simulated IAP — App Store Rejection

properties.description: Premium subscription purchase is simulated with setTimeout(r, 1800) — no real StoreKit/IAP integration. Apple will reject the app for bypassing in-app purchase APIs (App Store Review Guideline 3.1.1).

nodes.norm_label: risk: simulated iap — app store rejection

nodes.label: RISK: Simulated Options Trading — Misleading UI

properties.description: Options buy action uses setTimeout simulation — no real on-chain execution. Private key is loaded but not used. Presents as a real financial trading feature. App Store Review may flag as misleading/non-functional.
properties.app_store_impact: RISK of rejection for non-functional financial feature

nodes.norm_label: risk: simulated options trading — misleading ui

nodes.label: RISK: Earn Deposit is Coming Soon — Incomplete Feature

properties.description: Deposit button shows Alert.alert('Coming Soon') — no DeFi integration. Non-functional UI in production build.
properties.app_store_impact: RISK of rejection for non-functional feature (Guideline 2.1)

nodes.norm_label: risk: earn deposit is coming soon — incomplete feature

properties.description: window.opener.postMessage({ type: 'KRYPTONOW_AUTH_SUCCESS', dest }, '*') uses wildcard origin '*'. Any malicious page that opened the popup can receive the auth success message.
properties.app_store_impact: Security — could be exploited in web build

nodes.label: RISK: Demo Seed Data in Production Build

properties.description: seedDemoNotifications() is called on every load of the notifications screen — will populate fake notification data in production builds during App Store review.
properties.app_store_impact: May confuse reviewers or be flagged as misleading content

nodes.norm_label: risk: demo seed data in production build

nodes.label: RISK: EIP-1193 Provider Init Blocked by Empty Phrase

properties.description: kryptoNowProvider is initialized only when wallet.phrase is truthy. After mnemonic import (import.tsx), phrase is stored as empty string '', so dApp connections will silently fail for imported wallets.
properties.app_store_impact: Broken dApp connectivity for imported wallets

nodes.norm_label: risk: eip-1193 provider init blocked by empty phrase

nodes.label: RISK: Hardware Wallet Data in localStorage

properties.description: Hardware wallet address, type, and derivation path stored in localStorage (kn_hw_address, kn_hw_type, kn_hw_path). localStorage is unencrypted and XSS-accessible.

nodes.norm_label: risk: hardware wallet data in localstorage

nodes.label: RISK: No Error Boundaries on Any Screen

properties.description: None of the 23 analyzed screens implement React error boundaries. An uncaught render error in any screen will crash the entire app rather than showing a recovery UI.
properties.app_store_impact: Stability risk — crashes increase App Store rejection probability

nodes.norm_label: risk: no error boundaries on any screen

properties.description: ENS resolution uses hardcoded RPC 'https://eth.llamarpc.com' with no fallback. If this endpoint goes down, ENS resolution silently fails.

nodes.label: RISK: Analytics Contract Classification Always Returns 'contract'

properties.description: Contract signature matching is incomplete — the function always returns the string 'contract' regardless of actual interaction type. Analytics categorization is inaccurate.

nodes.norm_label: risk: analytics contract classification always returns 'contract'

nodes.label: RISK: Trezor Script Dynamically Injected from External Origin

properties.description: Trezor Connect script is dynamically injected from connect.trezor.io at runtime. If the CDN is compromised or the URL is intercepted, malicious JS could be executed with wallet access.

nodes.norm_label: risk: trezor script dynamically injected from external origin

nodes.label: RISK: No Biometric Authentication Fallback on Lock Screen

properties.description: Lock screen only supports 6-digit PIN with no biometric (Face ID / Touch ID) fallback, reducing usability and security for iOS users.
properties.app_store_impact: UX concern — not a rejection risk

nodes.norm_label: risk: no biometric authentication fallback on lock screen
